name: Drill Bird: Cursed Mode
summary: In Cursed Mode, a demon offers to make your child supremely powerful - but to do so you must be reincarnated into a brand new world filled with new puzzles, enemies and secrets. You’ll find the difficulty has been raised a notch, designed as a natural continuation of the base game.
